TASKS.title: Restrict caller lineage in log entries to 4 by default, restrict to 1 for INFO/GOOD, restrict to 4 for WARN/ERROR
description: Currently, log entries can have an unbounded caller lineage which can lead to excessively long log entries that are difficult to read and manage.
To improve readability and manageability of log entries, we will implement a restriction on the caller lineage included in log entries.

By default, we will limit the caller lineage to 4 levels. For INFO and GOOD level logs, we will restrict the caller lineage to just 1 level to keep these logs concise. For WARN and ERROR level logs, we will allow up to 4 levels of caller lineage to provide more context for troubleshooting while still maintaining readability.

This change will involve updating the logging mechanism to enforce these restrictions based on the log level and ensuring that the appropriate amount of caller information is included in each log entry.

TASKS.title: Task Management Interface
description: Create a task management interface that provides the ability to create tasks both programmatically and through a user interface.
